Quiet corners, a few notes late today
We write to travelers

Companion Animal Travel Desk

Travelers with pets should bring clear papers, sturdy carriers, and calm routines for check-in. Please keep food, water, bedding, and comfort items ready so the handoff stays smooth and safe. Aurelia Skyways asks crews to follow the care notes closely, since each animal may need a different pace and a quieter place to rest. <<FACT F008>> The skyport team will guide you on carrier checks, walk-on steps, and any last reviews before boarding.

For companion travel, simple planning helps. Keep your pet close, speak softly, and avoid sudden changes in movement or noise. If your animal needs a special setup, tell the desk early so the records stay clear and the crew can prepare the right space. <<FACT F022>> The lounge staff will use the posted rules and the travel notes together, which helps keep the process steady for everyone.

Please bring all concerns to the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure, and we will help you sort the details with care.
